title: The Excalibur Group
description: About The Excalibur Group The Excalibur Group is a Washington D.C. based company that focuses on enhancing local, state, and federal programs through staff augmentation, training, and program management in the Defense, IT, Workforce, Environmental, and Legal sectors. They provide specialized job training and placement services for individuals in various industries, including transitioning soldiers. The company also offers both permanent and contingent labor to support clients' internal IT and R&D projects. Their mission is to deliver efficient contract management and cost-effective solutions while promoting meaningful Veteran employment. Company The Excalibur Group was attacked, resulting in the theft of more than 600 GB of confidential data, such as banking and other financial information, personal data of employees and customers, and information marked “secret”. Currently, more than 400,000 files are not protected by The Excalibur Group
